description: No mod manager, an Old-Gen game whose Data holds one case of every data check, scanned once with every box ticked and then with each box alone. Race Subgraphs: two enabled modules with 60 and 41 SADD records (101, over the threshold) and DLCCoast.esm, a folder, skipped as unreadable. The walk: Data's root files under the pseudo-root Data (junk, a DLL, archives with no, a bad, a foreign-language and a valid suffix, one enabled only by the INI, a whitelisted base-game name, a .vortex_backup skipped), then each top-level folder in NTFS order for the progress label: BodySlide and Meshes/Source and Scripts/Source pruned as skip dirs, fomod a junk folder, Interface and DLCCoast.esm pruned as not whitelisted, Vis loose previs, precombined (twice, at any depth) and AnimTextData under Meshes, wrong formats with and without a proper sibling (one found only by case), F4SE DLLs outside Plugins (and the PluginsExtra prefix quirk), and an F4SE script name in Scripts that never fires without a mod file index. The worker never queues the top-level folder tuple (bug #89), so every folder name is ignored and the scanning label stays on 'Building mod file index...' with the progress at 1 until the results replace them. Port: fixed, see deviations #23, #89.

deviations.reason: The results tree lists its groups in the order their problem types first appear in the results, the same every run, instead of in Python's per-process set order.

The walk's root is recognised by position, not identity: the Data folder tuple is queued so the scan shows 'Scanning... i/n: folder' progress, and each mod root goes into modules and archives instead of the folder '.'.
